EXECUTIVE ORDER NO. 501 March 30, 1978
CREATING A NATIONAL COMMITTEE TO TAKE CHARGE OF THE CELEBRATION OF
PHILIPPINE INDEPENDENCE DAY ON 12 JUNE 1978
Pursuant to the powers vested in me by law, I, FERDINAND E. MARCOS, President of the Philippines, do
hereby create a national committee to take charge of the celebration of Philippine Independence Day on June
12, 1978.
The Committee shall be composed of the following:
The Secretary of Education & Culture
The Secretary of Public Information
Vice Chairman
The Commissioner of the Budget
The Presidential Assistant on National Minorities
The Presidential Assistant on Legal Affairs
The Undersecretary of Public Works
The Undersecretary of Labor
The Undersecretary of National Defense
The Undersecretary of Trade
The Undersecretary of Local Gov'ts. and Community Development
The Undersecretary of Tourism
The Undersecretary of Youth and Sports Development
The Mayor of Manila
The Chairman, National Historical Commission
The Director, National Media Production Center
The President, Philippine Assn. of Colleges and Universities
The President, Civic Assembly of Women of the Philippines
The Presidential Protocol Officer
Member-Secretary
The Committee shall meet at the call of the Chairman and for the purpose of discharging its functions, may
create its sub-committees as may be necessary.
The Committee is hereby authorized to call upon any department, bureau, office, agency or instrumentality of
the Government, including government-owned or controlled corporations, for such assistance as it may need
in the discharge of its duties and function.
Done in the City of Manila, this 30th day of March, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and
seventy-eight.
